svg.title: RetroLauncher — cartridge shelf and loading storyboard
svg.desc: Six proposed 160 by 144 screens: browse, navigate, pick up, insert, click, and an explicitly labeled unimplemented game handoff.

g.text: 160 × 144 logical pixels · schematic label artwork · design preview, not a playable compilation
One cartridge, a readable title, a position
A selects. The cartridge shrinks and lifts
The cartridge moves behind the console
A short mechanical click lands with a
Proposed: start the selected game. This
preview stops here; B returns to the shelf.
Music direction: the original site track. Native audio conversion, game switching, and return from real games remain unresolved.
